summary: So Sanders wins the Birkenstock Beltway, big deal., and not by huge delegate margins. Biden won, and will win everything else, especially if Warren stays in and splits progressive vote. This primary is over.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: So Sanders wins the Birkenstock Beltway, big deal., and not by huge delegate margins. Biden won, and will win everything else, especially if Warren stays in and splits progressive vote. This primary is over.
